pages.title: Vacuum Energy Cell
pages.text: Energy borrowed from the vacuum itself, stored with exotic matter to keep the books balanced. Inside, graviton crystal holds the field taut while a dark matter lens focuses it. It feels heavier when full, though nothing has been added.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Casimir cell ran out of gap. I needed more vacuum to work with, so I folded in exotic matter for negative energy, graviton crystal for structure and a dark matter lens to concentrate the field.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Singularity Energy Cell.
